issues.source_quote: Поскользнулся, упал... Закрытый перелом... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс.
issues.translation_quote: Closed fracture... Lost consciousness, woke up - plaster cast.
issues.justification: Fine as a refrain, but the later pun 'не закрытый, а открытый перелом' is rendered literally and the joke about 'open' fracture (implying hidden contents) is not made clear; the humor weakens.

issues.source_quote: Лёгким движением руки брюки превращаются... в элегантные шорты!
issues.translation_quote: turn the jacket... into a windbreaker
issues.justification: 'Куртка' rendered as 'windbreaker' is a questionable choice; 'jacket' contrasting with 'пиджак' (suit jacket) is better rendered as 'blazer... into a jacket'.

issues.source_quote: Хорошо, что он не контрабандист, симпатичный мужик...
issues.translation_quote: Good thing he's not a smuggler, nice guy...
issues.justification: Acceptable; flagged for style: the register is fine. Low confidence.

issues.source_quote: Что случилось, почему шеф здесь? ... Но у Белой Скалы нет клёва... Клёв!... Клёв будет, это я беру на себя! Клевать будет так, что клиент позабудет обо всём на свете!
issues.translation_quote: They'll bite, I'll take care of that! They'll bite so well the client will forget everything in the world!
issues.justification: The double meaning of 'клёв' (fish biting and the client being hit) is lost partly; the switch from fish to client is not cleanly preserved.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, если человек идиот - то это надолго.
issues.translation_quote: As our beloved boss says, if a man is an idiot, it's for a long time.
issues.justification: The aphorism 'это надолго' is a deadpan quip meaning 'it's permanent'; English literal rendering is clumsy and loses the punch ('it's for life').
The fake-foreign gibberish is transliterated rather than adapted; minor.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Whoever takes a pack of tickets will get... A water tower!
issues.justification: The rhymed jingle (пачку/водокачку) is lost, and the joke of a ridiculous prize is flattened; 'water tower' isn't the same as a pumping station.
